scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/frontend && cd apps/backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build: npm run build:client && cd apps/backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build:full: npm run build:client && npm run docker:build
scripts.db:init: cd apps/backend && python -c "from app import db, app; with app.app_context(): db.create_all()"
